payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear methodology for how clusters were extracted using k-means clustering on word embeddings.

claims.text: Clusters were extracted using k-means clustering on word embeddings, initialized with 'k-means++' and run for 300 iterations.
The clustering process involved trying different values for the number of clusters and repeating the experiment with different seed initializations to minimize cluster inertia.
The embeddings used for clustering included GloVe vectors trained on Wikipedia articles and an in-domain corpus.
